known_secrets.text: Salt-crust has spread across three pastures usable in Roka's youth.
He has quietly shifted the herds' seasonal rotation without formal Assembly approval.
Nearly a third of old grazing land marked usable before the Turning is now salt-crusted.
He suspects the salt-crust spread and the woodland thinning share a common cause.

unknowns: The true underlying cause connecting the salt-crust, the thinning woodland, and the failing terraces
Meaning of the Signs on the seals
Whether the land will stabilize or keep degrading
